item.title: Loss Functions: The Only Thing Your ML Model Actually Cares About
item.description: While going deep into ML and neural networks, I kept running into this one idea over and over again: loss functions. And man, intuition has never been more important than here. You can memorize ten formulas, but if you don’t feel why each one exists, you’ll forget them in a week. So this is me trying to write it down in the simplest, most “explain it to future-me” way possible so that even if I forget everything else, I can read this and go “oh yeah, right” in five minutes.

item.title: Money Isn't Real (and that's what makes it powerful)
item.description:
imagine you’re stranded on an island with a suitcase containing ₹10 crore in cash.you can’t eat it. you can’t drink it. you can’t build a shelter with it. suddenly, the thing you’ve spent your entire life chasing becomes… paper.

so why does money have value?

the answer has almost nothing to do with the paper itself.

it has everything to do with one of the most powerful forces humans have ever created: shared belief

item.title: why i'm starting this
item.description:
This is me, roughly four, sitting in front of a laptop I definitely could not operate, grinning like I’d already figured it out. I hadn’t figured out anything. I think I just found the game of poker, which in my head I was winning.

Funny enough, that photo is a more accurate prediction of my life than what came next. Because for most of my life (more specifically in 9th grade), I actually wanted to be a neurosurgeon.
